title:
See {@link FaultySensor} for details about the overall faulty sensor process.

This type is an orchestrator that manages and creates the overarching {@link Workflow} to retrain models
as part of the faulty sensor process. The resulting workflow will likely contain several
{@link Workflow.Nested.Action}s that may contain other workflows managed by different orchestrators.

See #createAndRunWorkflow for the main entry point to this orchestrator.
name: FaultySensor.Orchestrator
